title: Smith Project Type
description: A versioned project-type definition from the registry (project-type.json). Name and version must match the registry layout: <language>/<flavor>/<kind>/v<version>/project-type.json.

name.description: Type name, language/flavor/kind. Flavor is mandatory: 'std' when the language has a standard toolchain, otherwise an arbitrary string unique within the language namespace.

version.description: Type version. Must equal the version directory in the registry path (app-level check).

capabilities.description: What this type of project can do, independent of how. Optional and non-load-bearing in the MVP.

tools.description: Tools required on PATH to run this type's targets (BYOT). Version constraints may be added later.

working_dir.description: Where targets execute: the project directory (default) or the repository root (e.g. docker build contexts). Exactly these two values — no arbitrary paths.

targets.description: Named targets, each a list of shell command steps run in order; the first non-zero exit fails the target.

depends_on.description: Target dependency map: target -> targets that must complete first. Referenced target names, self-references, and cycles are validated by smith (not expressible here).

params.description: Params this type exposes to its steps and environment values via {{.name}} templates. Defaults are required; manifests may override.

environment.description: Environment variables for this type's target steps. Values are Go templates over the merged params (type defaults <- manifest overrides).
